title: Initialization of buffered composition
statement: For any finite Turing machines $M_1,M_2$ over the Boolean alphabet and any Boolean word $x$, the initial configuration of their buffered sequential composition on $x$ equals the first-phase configuration embedding of $M_1$'s initial configuration on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $M_1,M_2$ are finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet
replaced:
For all machines $M_1$ and $M_2$ over the Boolean alphabet with finitely many
states and every input $x$, the initial configuration of the buffered
sequential composition of $M_1$ and $M_2$ on $x$ equals the first-phase
embedding of the initial configuration of $M_1$ on $x$, in which the buffer
stores the empty word.
